name: bollinger_ema_sar_v2_directional_slope
purpose: Repeat the V1 setup without changing Bollinger, EMA cross, SAR, structure, candle pattern, stop, or 3-bar/40%-band exit; replace only the overly restrictive monotonic EMA20 regime filter with a causal directional slope filter, and test LONG and SHORT as completely separate experiments.

unchanged_from_v1.long_structure: prior bar sweeps below latest confirmed swing low; signal closes back above it; signal low > prior low
unchanged_from_v1.short_structure: prior bar sweeps above latest confirmed swing high; signal closes back below it; signal high < prior high
unchanged_from_v1.signal_patterns: rocket rejection with wick >=70% body OR body engulfing
unchanged_from_v1.ema_cross: EMA3/EMA9 cross on the fully closed signal bar
unchanged_from_v1.ema9_close: signal closes on the correct side of EMA9
unchanged_from_v1.sar: below LONG signal / above SHORT signal
unchanged_from_v1.entry: open of the bar immediately after the fully closed signal candle
unchanged_from_v1.stop: LONG low of candle before signal; SHORT high of candle before signal
unchanged_from_v1.exit: 40% of Bollinger bandwidth from entry OR close after maximum 3 one-minute bars; active stop; conservative stop-first on same-bar ambiguity

only_change_from_v1.old_filter: EMA20 had to move monotonically in the trade direction on each of the last 3 closed transitions.
only_change_from_v1.new_filter: EMA20 directional slope over 5 closed bars, normalized by ATR14.
only_change_from_v1.sideways: NO_TRADE when the relevant directional threshold is not met
only_change_from_v1.optimization: Threshold 0.10 is fixed before this run and is not optimized in this discovery test.

direction_isolation.LONG: LONG signals only; SHORT signals are ignored and cannot affect position sequencing.
direction_isolation.SHORT: SHORT signals only; LONG signals are ignored and cannot affect position sequencing.

session_rule: No hard 09:00-12:00 ET gate. The NY anchor remains contextual only.
